lines.text: Hello! I’m Nib, the town clerk. I heard a rumour somebody new was coming, and there you are.
My big book has an ownerless page for Plot 11, out past the park. Nobody has lived on it since 1999.
No name at all. Just an old letter from the top drawer. I do love a page with a surprise in it.
“the eleventh plot, to whoever comes asking. it has waited long enough.”
It’s yours, but we must find who left it before you can put your name on Plot 11.
My big book only goes back to 1999. Old Peel in the Park is older than any book.
Go ask Old Peel about Plot 11. He hates official business. Wonderful.
I’ll be at the town hall, putting the drawer back where it belongs.

linesRes.text: Hello! I’m Nib, the town clerk. I heard you’d settled on Plot 11, so I came to write you in properly.
But its page is empty. Nobody has lived on it since 1999 in my big book.
No name, only an old letter from the top drawer.
“the eleventh plot, to whoever comes asking. it has waited long enough.”
We must find who left it before I can put your name on Plot 11.
My big book only goes back to 1999. Ask Old Peel in the Park about Plot 11. He hates official business. Wonderful.
I’ll be at the town hall.
